cases.translation: The Lord sent Nathan to David.
cases.explain: The accusative case marks the direct object of the verb послал.

cases.sentence: В одном городе было два ___, один богатый, а другой бедный.
cases.translation: In one city there were two men, one rich and one poor.
cases.explain: After numerals 2-4, the genitive singular is used.

cases.sentence: У богача было очень много мелкого и крупного ___.
cases.translation: The rich man had a great many flocks and herds.
cases.explain: The preposition много (much) takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: У бедняка не было ничего, кроме одной маленькой овечки, которую он ___.
cases.translation: The poor man had nothing except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought.
cases.explain: Past tense masculine singular shows the action of buying.

cases.sentence: К богачу пришел путник, чтобы попросить пищу, но богач проявил жадность к ___.
cases.translation: A traveler came to the rich man to ask for food, but the rich man showed greed toward the traveler.
cases.explain: The dative case shows the recipient or beneficiary.

cases.sentence: К богачу пришел путник, но богач пожалел взять что-либо из своего скота, чтобы приготовить пищу для пришедшего к нему ___.
cases.translation: A traveler came to the rich man, but the rich man was unwilling to take any of his own flock or herd to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) governing the recipient takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он должен заплатить за овечку ___,  потому что он сделал это и не имел сострадания.
cases.translation: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and had no pity.
cases.explain: Четырехкратно (fourfold) is an adverb modifying the verb заплатить.

cases.sentence: Сильно разгневался Давид на этого ___ и сказал Нафану, «Верно, как и то, что жив Господь, человек, который сделал это, заслуживает смерти».
cases.translation: David's anger was greatly kindled against the man, and he said to Nathan, 'As the Lord lives, the man who has done this thing deserves to die.'
cases.explain: The accusative case marks the direct object of the preposition на (against).

reading.ru: В одном городе было два человека, один богатый, а другой бедный.
reading.question: What did Nathan's parable begin with?
options: Two men in one city, one rich and one poor
reading.correct: Two men in one city, one rich and one poor
reading.explain: Nathan begins his parable by describing two men in one city - one rich and one poor.

reading.ru: У богача было очень много мелкого и крупного скота, а у бедняка не было ничего, кроме одной маленькой овечки, которую он купил.
reading.question: What did the rich man have compared to the poor man?
options: The rich man had many flocks while the poor man had only one small lamb
reading.correct: The rich man had many flocks while the poor man had only one small lamb
reading.explain: The contrast is clear: the rich man had many animals, but the poor man had only one ewe lamb.

reading.ru: Она ела из его тарелки, пила из его чаши и даже спала у него на груди. Она была у него как дочь.
reading.question: How did the poor man treat the lamb?
options: As a daughter - it ate from his plate, drank from his cup, and slept on his chest
reading.correct: As a daughter - it ate from his plate, drank from his cup, and slept on his chest
reading.explain: The text describes intimate care: the lamb ate from his plate, drank from his cup, and slept on his chest, like a daughter.

reading.ru: К богачу пришел путник, но богач пожалел взять что-либо из своего мелкого или крупного скота, чтобы приготовить пищу для пришедшего к нему путника.
reading.question: What did the rich man do when a traveler came?
options: He was unwilling to take any of his animals to prepare food for the traveler
He gave his best animals for a feast
reading.correct: He was unwilling to take any of his animals to prepare food for the traveler
reading.explain: Instead of providing for the traveler from his own flock, the rich man was stingy.

reading.ru: Вместо этого он взял овечку бедняка и приготовил ее для того, кто пришел к нему.
reading.question: Whose lamb did the rich man take?
reading.explain: Instead of taking from his own many animals, the rich man took the poor man's only lamb to feed the traveler.

reading.ru: Тогда Нафан сказал Давиду, «Ты тот человек».
reading.question: What did Nathan reveal to David with this statement?
options: That David himself was like the rich man who had wronged the poor
That David was a righteous judge
That David needed to punish someone
That Nathan was the poor man in the story
reading.correct: That David himself was like the rich man who had wronged the poor
reading.explain: Nathan reveals that David's own actions in taking Bathsheba and arranging Uriah's death made him like the wicked rich man in the parable.
